name: Kannagi Shion
source:
3rd year high school student.
The student council president.
He takes a cool and arrogant attitude around other people and is thought of as cruel.
There are lots of bad rumors spreading about him and he's feared as some kind of demon king type of man.
But in reality he's...

The five personality's you can switch him between are, 'charismatic', 'happy', 'carnivore', 'innocent', and 'tsundere'.
